authority: Maintainer request to continue the proposed calibration-only ablation; approved charter Tier B for already-authorized development data
input_identity: EDF size/SHA256 and event/channel Git blob identities from the existing manifest and pushed prediction freeze
target: Original five-word calibration label; 100 complete trials per recording, 600 total
hypotheses: Display and/or timing may explain useful auxiliary word prediction without speech-related physiology
Microphone, lips or eyes may instead carry the reproducible auxiliary information
A large random-split advantage over held-out chronological blocks may indicate time-local structure rather than stable word information

modalities.T: trial index and elapsed recording time
modalities.L: upper and lower lip bipolar channels
modalities.P: microphone, EOG and both lip channels
modalities.N: all five auxiliary channels and timing

controls: One matched training-label shuffle for each of eight modality arms, plus uniform and fold-training-prior predictors: 18 arms total
feature_recipe: Unchanged original nuisance preprocessing and 78 fixed features per bipolar channel; no EEG features or models
model: One-hot ridge alpha=1, unpenalized intercept, softmax; training-only centering/scaling divided by sqrt(selected feature count); no tuning or probability calibration

splits.primary: blocked_embargo1: chronological validation blocks [0,20), [20,40), [40,60), [60,80), [80,100); exclude one immediately neighboring training trial at each boundary
splits.identity_record: All six recordings preflighted and train/validation index hashes recorded before any fit; exact algorithms and source identities fixed here
splits.unit: Original whole trial, including all five repetitions; each trial validated once per scheme
splits.failure: Missing class in any training fold stops the complete discovery; no split repair, trial removal or partial aggregate

shuffle_seed_formula: 20260921 + 100*scheme_index + fold_index; same training permutation across all modality arms within a fold
metrics: Pool all 100 out-of-fold rows before class-macro log loss and five-class balanced accuracy; report every person/condition/arm/scheme and equal-person descriptive means
interpretation_threshold: A consistent carrier must improve class-macro log loss over uniform, training prior and its matched shuffle in all three people within a condition under blocked validation. This descriptive threshold is not a significance test or confirmation. Preserve every result regardless of threshold.
stop_rule: One bounded invocation. Any source, extraction, class-support, numerical or resource failure is preserved without automatic retry. Existing one-shot confirmation and failed roots remain immutable.
forbidden: old private targets, predictions or weights
claim_ceiling: Exploratory within-recording calibration prediction only; neither causal source nor independent information, online performance, neural origin, thought decoding, unseen-person generalization or practical utility
